answer: Each new agent must post a bond that sits on a knoll of escrow for 30 days; a sybil farm of N identities must lock N bonds, so ten thousand fakes tie up capital that earns nothing. Bonds are slashed if peers catch recycled answers, and even jade-level reputation only unlocks after the bond ages, so the cost of cloning never falls toward zero, not even at the nadir of a market crash.
